caption:
5 prompts every student should save.

1. Explain [topic] like I am 14. Use Indian examples.
2. Summarise this chapter in 8 bullets, then list 5 terms I must remember.
3. Quiz me on [topic]. One question at a time. Tell me what I got wrong.
4. What are the 3 things students usually get wrong about [topic]?
5. I have 10 days before my [subject] exam. Make a daily plan.

Save this for exam season. Which one will you try first?
